sample_replies.title: Send reply to Grace Wright: Re: How often should I replace the shower filter?

payload.body:
Hi Grace,

Thanks for your question! The 15-Stage Shower Head Filter cartridge should be replaced every 6 months (about 10,000 gallons). It fits standard 1/2-inch US shower arms. Use the included thread tape to prevent leaks; hand-tighten only.

Best regards,
The Northpeak Support Team
